turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have had a cough for five days.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Any chest pain or shortness of breath?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No chest pain. I do get a little short of breath when I climb stairs.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Your lungs sound clear. This looks viral, so rest and fluids for now.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: How long should I wait before calling?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Call if it lasts more than two weeks or you spike a fever.
